# inkscape-mcp — LLM index (llms.txt)

inkscape-mcp — an MCP server that makes Inkscape/SVG documents agent-ready: inspect, edit safely (reversible), validate, render, and export.

Surface: 10 tools, 7 prompts, 17 resources.

## Run & transport
Transport: STDIO only (local). No HTTP.
Run: uv run inkscape-mcp
Console script: inkscape-mcp = inkscape_mcp.server:main

## Environment / configuration
Workspace roots (required): INKSCAPE_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOTS (OS-path-separator-delimited list of allowed dirs; the sandbox boundary).
Operator-tunable limits / gates (all optional, env-overridable):
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ACTION_ALLOWLIST
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ARTIFACT_KEEP_DAYS
  - INKSCAPE_MCP_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES

## Tools (one line + risk class, grouped by category)

### Author
- edit [risk: high] — Change a document with typed ops in ONE atomic call (all or nothing, one snapshot; undo with history): create shapes, restyle, move, group, text, compose, optimize. Refer to an op's new object as '$<op index>'; target existing ones with ids=[...] or select={tag,fill,...}. render='inline' returns a PNG; dry_run=true the plan. HIGH ops (delete, set_svg, insert_svg, path ops) need approval_token. help(op=NAME) shows fields. Example: edit(doc_id, ops=[{'op':'create_rect','x':0,'y':0,'width':200,'height':100,'fill':'#36f','id':'bg'},{'op':'fill','ids':['$0'],'color':'#f63'}], render='inline')
- open [risk: medium] — Start working: returns a doc_id. Give exactly ONE source: path (existing SVG in the workspace), svg (SVG text), canvas {width,height,viewBox?,background?} (blank page) or from_live {dest_path} (save the live Inkscape canvas into the workspace). Optional `ops` run the first edit in the same call (same format as edit; render='inline' returns a PNG). Example: open(canvas={'width':800,'height':600,'background':'#fff'}, ops=[{'op':'create_circle','cx':400,'cy':300,'r':100,'fill':'#f63'}], render='inline')

### Inspect
- inspect [risk: low] — Read-only view of one document (or several: pass a list of doc_ids). `include` picks sections: summary (default), objects, tree, layers, styles, fonts, assets, validate, quality, snapshots, frames. `select` filters `objects` (tag, fill, stroke, text, id_prefix, bbox) so you need no separate find call; giving only `select` returns just the objects, as [id, tag, bbox, fill] rows capped by `limit` (truncated=true when cut). detail: ids | summary | full. Example: inspect(doc_id, select={'tag': 'rect'})
- render [risk: low] — Render the document as a PNG you can see inline. target='page' (default): the whole page; 'object': one object clipped to its box (needs object_id); 'frame': the next numbered frame of a `series` (a screenshot log; optional `label`). width_px sets the raster width. Use it after edits to check the result (edit(render='inline') already includes one render). Example: render(doc_id, target='object', object_id='logo', width_px=512)

### Export
- export [risk: high] — Write results to files in the workspace. `targets` is a list of: {kind:'file', format:'png|pdf|svg', object_id?, width_px?}, {kind:'profile', name:'web|icons|print', ...} or {kind:'save_as', dest_path, overwrite?}. doc_id may be a list to export a set (files are prefixed with each doc_id). dry_run=true plans and projects sizes without writing; byte_budget caps the total. Returns each artifact's workspace path, size and pixel dimensions. Example: export(doc_id, targets=[{'kind':'file','format':'png','width_px':1024},{'kind':'file','format':'svg'}])

### History
- history [risk: medium] — Undo/redo safety net. Every edit already writes one snapshot. action='list' shows them; 'create' checkpoints now (optional label); 'restore' rolls the working copy back to `snapshot_id` (itself reversible: it snapshots first); 'prune' reclaims old snapshots; 'reload' re-reads the source file under the same doc_id (pre-reload snapshot taken). Example: history(doc_id, action='restore', snapshot_id='snap-0003')

### Live
- live [risk: medium] — Look at (and steer the view of) a running Inkscape. action='observe' with include=[document, selection, inspect, scene, view] returns those parts in one call ('view' is an inline PNG of the canvas; region/scale/fast shape it); 'wait' blocks until something changes; 'viewport' (mode, zoom, center_x/y, dx/dy) moves the view; 'diff' (operation_id) shows what a live_edit changed; 'export_selection' renders the selection. Setup: check, connect, disconnect, status, install_helper, arm_socket. Connects automatically. Example: live(action='observe', include=['selection','inspect','view'], fast=true)
- live_edit [risk: high] — Change the live Inkscape selection. action='apply' with style {fill, stroke, stroke_width, opacity} and/or transform {dx, dy, scale, rotate}; 'insert_svg' with svg_fragment; 'set_text' with text. observe='render' returns an inline PNG of the canvas afterwards, 'diff' a before/after overlay, 'none' just the result. Always HIGH risk: needs approval_token. Connects automatically. Example: live_edit(action='apply', style={'fill':'#f63'}, observe='render', approval_token='ok')

### Advanced
- actions [risk: high] — Advanced escape hatch: allowlisted Inkscape Actions. action='list' shows what this runtime exposes (all=false omits the id array), 'extensions' the allowlisted extensions, 'validate' checks `steps` [{action, args[]}] without running, 'run' executes the chain on doc_id, 'raw' runs ONE step (dry_run defaults to true). Running is HIGH risk: needs approval_token. Prefer edit ops when one exists. Example: actions(action='run', doc_id=d, steps=[{'action':'select-all'}], approval_token='ok')

### Help
- help [risk: low] — Ask for guidance. goal='make the svg smaller' -> matching tools; op='fill' -> that edit op's fields, risk and a valid example; topic='ops' lists every op, 'capabilities' shows what this runtime supports, 'diagnose' re-probes it; stat_paths=[...] returns size + sha256 of workspace files. No arguments: the short workflow. Example: help(op='create_rect')
